title: Guest Chat observer rejects documented versioned-route fallback after successful replies
surface: Hosted native guest Chat acceptance observer
organization_context: No account token, profile, or organization; public guest route
preconditions: Published Store CRX 0.2.205 loaded unpacked in hosted native Chromium under its Store identity.
Live Aidream server SHA efe1eb6efead949c0b5cb179dc762a8674770cff serves canonical /ai route but lacks the documented /v2/ai alias.
reproduction: Run hosted guest Chat acceptance 39046184558 against the fixed published Store CRX and the live server.
Opening, same-conversation follow-up, and post-reload turns each emit two observed requests, status 404 then 200; each pair retains the same conversation fingerprint and is_new value.
The side panel displays three terminal answers, while requireGuestConversationSequence fails because it requires exactly one POST per turn.
expected: Observer records only sanitized route class and accepts a single successful canonical or versioned route, or exactly versioned /v2/ai 404/405 followed by canonical /ai 200 with the same conversation identity and is_new. It rejects arbitrary duplicates, wrong-path fallback, and mismatched turn state.
actual: Original observer omitted route path and required exactly one POST. The resource-valid browser run therefore failed its observer assertion despite three completed terminal answers. Run retains zero acceptance credit.
reproducibility: Original observer failed deterministically on the captured two-request-per-turn sequence. Corrected observer focused tests pass 9/9; forcing mutation requiring one request returns expected RED and restores source byte-identically via plant.py. Independent review and fresh browser retest pending.
severity: S2: hosted acceptance false failure and zero credit
priority: P1: repair observer before next guarded guest Chat run
cause: Observer matched requests only by canonical suffix and dropped route class, then asserted exactly one POST. The client’s supported fallback produces a versioned-route rejection followed by canonical retry when the versioned alias is unavailable.
sibling_census: Observer guard is specific to EXT-F-2013-T10. Separate Aidream defect is the removed /v2/ai router alias (deletion commit 64bf4f37f9), causing the first 404; server owner is restoring the alias. Extension correction accepts only documented 404/405 versioned to 200 canonical fallback and does not mask arbitrary duplicates. Cross-repo server defect is EXT-D-0227; its route test is aidream/api/tests/test_v2_ai_start_routes.py and its candidate patch remains under peer review.
acceptance_criteria: Capture sanitized path class for each matching request without retaining raw URLs or auth values.
Accept only one 200 on a known chat route or exactly v2 404/405 then canonical 200 with matching conversation fingerprint and is_new.
Reject arbitrary duplicate success, wrong-path fallback, non-404/405 first status, and conversation/is_new mismatch.
Focused tests pass and forcing mutation proves failure before independent source review.
A fresh guarded native browser run must pass before any acceptance credit; distinguish public CRX loaded unpacked from Web Store-installed UI.
